title: sysmlc: compiling SysML v2 models into digital logic (code and data)
description: Compiler from a SysML v2 textual subset to SMT formulas, Verilog and Lustre, with the models, scripts, baseline runs and reference results of the article 'Systems Models as Logic Circuits: Compiling a SysML v2 Subset into Digital Logic for Analysis' (submitted to Software and Systems Modeling).
